requirements.text: Article 105 is applied to all fair-valued assets, and the resulting additional value adjustments are deducted from CET1 capital.
requirements.level_reason: Application of prudent valuation to all fair-valued assets and the CET1 deduction are evidenced in the institution's own funds calculation.

requirements.text: Documented valuation policies define responsibilities, market data sources and their review, use of unobservable inputs, independent valuation frequency, closing price timing, adjustment and verification procedures.
requirements.level_reason: Valuation policies are institution-wide policies evidenced in the valuation policy framework, not in a specific model's documentation.

requirements.text: Where marking to market is not possible, positions are conservatively marked to model, including for own funds calculation.
Model market inputs are sourced in line with market prices where possible, and the appropriateness of inputs and model parameters is assessed frequently.

Internally developed valuation models rest on assumptions challenged by qualified independent parties; the model is developed or approved independently of trading desks and independently tested, including mathematics, assumptions and software implementation.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against consolidated CRR text (CELEX 02013R0575-20250629). Independence and testing sentence is the second subparagraph of Art. 105(7).

requirements.text: Formal change control procedures apply to valuation models, and a secure copy of the model is held and used periodically to check valuations.

Valuation models are periodically reviewed for accuracy, including continued appropriateness of assumptions, P&L versus risk factor analysis and comparison of actual close-out values with model outputs.
Market prices and model inputs are verified at least monthly by a person or unit independent from those benefiting from the trading book.
requirements.level_reason: Independent price verification is an institution-level product control process evidenced in IPV procedures and reports.

requirements.text: The institution formally considers valuation adjustments for unearned credit spreads, close-out costs, operational risks, market price uncertainty, early termination, investing and funding costs, future administrative costs and, where relevant, model risk.
For complex products, the need for valuation adjustments for model risk from a possibly incorrect valuation methodology and from unobservable calibration parameters is explicitly assessed.

A model risk AVA is estimated for each valuation model, reflecting the range of models and calibrations used by market participants; uncertainty from market-derived calibration parameters is captured in the market price uncertainty AVA.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101. EBA amending RTS (consultation EBA/CP/2024/01) not reflected; check whether adopted. Core approach applies where fair-valued assets and liabilities are EUR 15 bn or more (Art. 4(1)).

requirements.text: Where possible, the model risk AVA is derived from a range of plausible valuations produced by alternative appropriate models and calibrations, at the 90 % confidence exit point.
requirements.quote: where they are 90 % confident they could exit the valuation exposure at that price or better
requirements.verification_note: Checked against OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101. EBA amending RTS (consultation EBA/CP/2024/01) not reflected; check whether adopted.

requirements.text: Where alternative models cannot be used, an expert-based model risk AVA considers product complexity, diversity of approaches, one-way markets, unhedgeable risks and payoff adequacy, and is notified to the competent authority.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101. EBA amending RTS (consultation EBA/CP/2024/01) not reflected; check whether adopted.

requirements.text: The prudence of the expert-based model risk AVA is confirmed annually against the alternative-models method on a material sample of valuation models.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101. EBA amending RTS (consultation EBA/CP/2024/01) not reflected; check whether adopted.

requirements.text: Valuation model performance is reviewed at least annually.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101. EBA amending RTS (consultation EBA/CP/2024/01) not reflected; check whether adopted.

requirements.text: Thresholds based on observed market data are defined to determine when valuation models are no longer sufficiently robust.
requirements.verification_note: Checked against OJ text of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101. EBA amending RTS (consultation EBA/CP/2024/01) not reflected; check whether adopted.
